description: US Department of Transportation open data portal (datahub.transportation.gov) is an open data portal listed in US Department of Transportation open data portal (datahub.transportation.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a national body, published or maintained by US Department of Transportation. datahub.transportation.gov is the open data portal of US Department of Transportation for United States. The infrastructure search read 321 of its datasets; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water or digital network, asset or facility are catalogued as records of their own, and the rest (permits, budgets, crime, health, planning, culture and similar) ... Coverage: United States. 321 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 1 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-transportation-gov-portal.
